State Board Of Administration Of Florida Retirement System increased its stake in Marvell Technology Group Ltd (MRVL) by 40.4% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 842,927 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $16.27M, up from 600,379 at the end of the previous reported quarter. State Board Of Administration Of Florida Retirement System who had been investing in Marvell Technology Group Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $10.03 billion market cap company. The stock increased 5.86% or $0.85 during the last trading session, reaching $15.26. About 7.53M shares traded. Marvell Technology Group Ltd. (NASDAQ:MRVL) has declined 30.23% since December 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 30.23% the S&P500.
State Board Of Administration Of Florida Retirement System, which manages about $39.36B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Visa Inc (NYSE:V) by 42,760 shares to 2.48 million shares, valued at $372.74M in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 180,042 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 6.54 million shares, and cut its stake in Pnc Finl Svcs Group Inc (NYSE:PNC).
